subtopics.title: Governance, Schemes and Infrastructure
subtopics.summary: This subtopic covers the NOTA voting option, the PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar scheme, the Sujal Gaon ID for rural piped water schemes, and the Namo Bharat rapid transit system. Each item is a domestic initiative with a defined objective, implementing body or ministry, and timeline.
facts: NOTA allows voters to reject all candidates in an election while still taking part in the democratic process.
NOTA was introduced by the Supreme Court in PUCL vs Union of India (2013).
The Supreme Court observed that NOTA has had limited impact on parties' candidate selection over a decade.
NOTA was used in the 2013 Assembly Elections in Chhattisgarh, Mizoram, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Delhi.
PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana was launched in 2024 and is described as the world's largest domestic rooftop solar initiative.
Target: rooftop solar in 1 crore households, with free electricity up to 300 units per month.
Financial support: subsidy of up to 40% of installation cost; nodal ministry is MNRE; scheme runs till FY 2026-27.
Sujal Gaon ID, launched by the Ministry of Jal Shakti, digitally maps rural piped water schemes under Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0.
Each Sujal Gaon ID is linked to a Sujalam Bharat ID.
Namo Bharat RRTS is a rail-based semi-high speed (up to 180 km/h) commuter system for inter-city travel within the NCR, implemented by NCRTC.

subtopics.title: International Organisations and Regional Groupings
subtopics.summary: This subtopic covers the World Health Organization, the Commission on the Status of Women, the BIMSTEC grouping and the Three Seas Initiative. Argentina's exit from the WHO and India's standing in the CSW are the main current developments.
facts: WHO is a specialised agency of the United Nations responsible for global public health governance.
WHO's constitution was drafted in 1946; the organisation came into force on 7 April 1948 and has 192 member States.
WHO functions through six regional offices and is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
Argentina is exiting the WHO after a one-year notice, citing sovereignty concerns and dissatisfaction with the COVID-19 response.
The Commission on the Status of Women was established in 1946 as the principal intergovernmental body of the UN for gender equality and women's empowerment.
The Commission functions under ECOSOC, receives secretariat support from UN Women, and has 45 member States elected for four-year terms.
India was elected to the Commission for 2021-25 and re-elected for 2025-29.
BIMSTEC (Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation) was established in 1997 by the Bangkok Declaration and has 7 member countries.
India hosted the BIMSTEC Youth Heritage and Sustainability Programme in Madhya Pradesh, organised by the Ministry of External Affairs and Bharat Scouts.
The Three Seas Initiative is a regional platform of 13 EU countries located between three seas; it was initiated in 2016 by Poland and Croatia.

subtopics.title: Trade and Energy Diplomacy
subtopics.summary: This subtopic covers the Most Favoured Nation principle in WTO trade, the India-EU services agreement, the Texas oil refinery project, and the characteristics of light shale oil. The MFN rule is the main trade concept tested here.
facts: Most Favoured Nation (MFN) requires a country to treat all WTO members equally in trade concessions.
If a country gives lower tariffs, market access or favourable treatment to one country, it must extend the same to all WTO members.
MFN ensures non-discriminatory global trade.
India and the EU agreed to grant MFN status in trade in services for 5 years.
Reliance Industries Limited was announced as a key partner in the $300 billion Texas Oil Refinery Project.
The Texas refinery is a major new oil refinery constructed in the USA since 1977, developed by America First Refining.
The refinery is located in the Permian Basin (the largest oil-producing region in the USA) and at the Port of Brownsville in South Texas.
Light shale oil is a low-density crude trapped in low-permeability shale or tight sandstone formations.
Light shale oil has low sulphur content and a high hydrogen-to-carbon ratio.

subtopics.title: Environment, Wildlife and Space
subtopics.summary: This subtopic covers the National Highways Green Cover Index, Project Cheetah, Him-CONNECT and asteroid 2024 YR4. Each item names an implementing body, a key figure or date, and a specific programme or discovery detail.
facts: NHAI released the first annual report of its National Highways Green Cover Index for 2025-26, prepared in collaboration with the National Remote Sensing Centre (ISRO).
The Green Cover Assessment surveyed 30,000 km of National Highways across 24 States.
The index uses high-resolution satellite imagery from Resourcesat-2 and Resourcesat-2A.
Assam recorded the highest highway green cover at 53.16%, followed by Gujarat and Telangana.
Project Cheetah is India's flagship wildlife conservation initiative, launched in 2022 and implemented by the National Tiger Conservation Authority (MoEFCC).
Project Cheetah operates under the umbrella of Project Tiger and aims to reintroduce cheetahs, officially extinct in India since 1952.
Cheetahs were brought from Namibia (8, in 2022) and South Africa (12, in 2023), and 9 cheetahs from Botswana arrived at Kuno National Park.
Him-CONNECT, launched by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change at WSDS 2026, bridges high-level scientific research and grassroots entrepreneurship.
Him-CONNECT was developed under the National Mission on Himalayan Studies to link research with implementation in the Himalayan region.
Asteroid 2024 YR4 was discovered in 2024 by the ATLAS observatory in Chile; NASA confirmed it will not hit the Moon after James Webb Space Telescope observations.
Asteroid 2024 YR4 is an S-type asteroid of the Apollo group, composed mainly of silicate minerals and nickel-iron metals.

subtopics.title: Sports and Places in News
subtopics.summary: This subtopic covers the first Khelo India Tribal Games, scheduled for Chhattisgarh in 2026, and the Lipulekh Pass, which is set to reopen for border trade with China. The Games aim to bring tribal sporting talent into the national ecosystem.
facts: The Khelo India Scheme was launched in 2016-17 by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
Chhattisgarh is set to host the first-ever Khelo India Tribal Games in 2026.
The Tribal Games integrate tribal sporting talent into India's national sports ecosystem while preserving traditional indigenous games.
Sports included in the Tribal Games: Mallakhamb and Kabaddi.
Organising bodies: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Sports Authority of India and Indian Olympic Association.
Morveer is the mascot, representing pride, bravery and cultural identity of tribal communities.
Lipulekh Pass is in the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand and is a tri-junction of India, Nepal and China (Tibet region).
India is set to resume border trade with China via Lipulekh Pass after a six-year COVID-induced suspension.
Lipulekh Pass is a key route for the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra.

quizzes.passage: The Governance, Schemes and Infrastructure section of the March 2026 round-up covers four domestic initiatives. The first concerns elections. A formal electoral option was introduced to give voters a way to express dissatisfaction with the candidates on offer, while strengthening democratic participation and voter freedom. The Supreme Court has also observed how this option has affected political parties over the past decade. The second item is a rooftop solar programme launched in 2024. It is described as the world's largest domestic rooftop solar initiative, and it aims to reach one crore households. Households that take part receive free electricity up to a set monthly limit, and the programme runs till FY 2026-27. The third item concerns rural water supply, which is covered under Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0. The round-up notes that the initiative aims to improve governance, monitoring and service delivery in rural areas. The fourth item is a rapid transit system. The Prime Minister inaugurated India's first Namo Bharat Regional Rapid Transit System, a rail-based service in the National Capital Region. Its implementing agency is a joint venture of the Government of India and several state governments. Each entry in the round-up is set out with its own details, so the items can be read separately.

quizzes.passage: Four domestic initiatives appear under the governance and infrastructure heading of the March 2026 round-up. One of them gives voters a formal way to reject every candidate standing in an election while still taking part in democratic life. Its stated purpose is to let citizens express dissatisfaction and to strengthen voter freedom. Another initiative is a rooftop solar scheme launched in 2024, which is described as the world's largest domestic rooftop solar initiative. Its objective is to install rooftop systems in one crore households, and participants receive free electricity up to a monthly limit. The scheme's subsidy covers a share of the installation cost, and it runs till FY 2026-27. A third initiative is the Sujal Gaon ID, launched by the Ministry of Jal Shakti. It assigns a unique, scheme-based digital identifier to every rural piped drinking water supply scheme, creating a digital record that supports governance and monitoring. Finally, the Namo Bharat system is a rail-based commuter service built for travel within the National Capital Region. It is a semi-high speed system, and its implementing agency is a joint venture of several governments. The round-up gives each entry its own heading and short summary. Each entry is short, and the items are listed one after another within the section.
